hero.description: Computer Engineer and Solutions Architect at Capgemini Invent. I work on cloud and software architecture, distributed systems and applied AI.

aboutMe.description: I am a Solutions Architect at Capgemini Invent, working inside Repsol's development architecture service. I review and design architectures on Azure, AWS and hybrid environments, write technical standards for the development lifecycle and take part in the corporate framework for adopting AI agents across the SDLC.
aboutMe.p1: I graduated in Computer Engineering from UCLM (bilingual track), first in my cohort. I hold the AWS Solutions Architect Associate certification and I am studying a Master's in Big Data and Cloud Computing.
aboutMe.p2: Outside work I keep my own projects going so I stay close to the code. The ones on this page are designed and built by me, with the architecture decisions documented in each repository.

education.title: Master's Degree in Big Data and Cloud Computing
Advanced University Course in Digital Tools Applied to Transportation and Logistics
education.description: A course focused on emerging technologies and agile methodologies applied to logistics and transportation, highlighting Agile project management (Scrum, Kanban), Cloud computing (AWS, Lambda, EC2, S3), AI, Big Data, Blockchain, robotics, and cybersecurity

education.title: Computer Engineering
education.description: Undergraduate Degree in Computer Engineering (bilingual modality), focused on software development, distributed systems, and systems architecture

education.title: Undergraduate Degree Programme in Medicine
education.description: Studies in Medicine, providing a multidisciplinary perspective (unfinished)

items.title: Solutions Architect
items.description: Design and review of application architectures on Azure, AWS and hybrid environments for the development architecture service. Architecture documents (DSA), technical standards and platform guidelines. Corporate framework for adopting AI agents across the development lifecycle: RAG indexing, deployment model, access, security and integration.

items.title: Full Stack Developer (internship)
items.description: Built applications with Angular and Spring Boot, persistence with JPA/Hibernate and migrations with Liquibase. Continuous integration with Jenkins and deployment on Apache and Tomcat.

mortgage.title: Mortgage Analyst
mortgage.description: Mortgage comparison for the Spanish market that ranks offers by total cost in euros over the life of the loan, under Euribor scenarios, including the bank's linked products and each region's purchase tax. Hexagonal architecture in Maven modules with rules checked by ArchUnit on every build, money always in BigDecimal, SCD2 offer versioning and Euribor ingestion from Banco de España. Decisions are recorded in 12 ADRs.

lucyerp.title: LucyERP
lucyerp.description: ERP for aesthetic clinics: room-based scheduling, clients, sales, stock and cash register, with automatic reminders through the WhatsApp Business Cloud API. It runs on the clinic's PC as a Windows service, with the whole database in a single SQLite file and scheduled backups.

relay.title: Relay Traffic Copilot
relay.description: AI copilot for a self-employed haulier working with Amazon Relay. It reads load offers from email, computes the real profit per km including empty legs and the official diesel price, and drafts a negotiation reply in Spanish and English. Every action needs human approval in the dashboard.

peaje.title: peaje
peaje.description: Self-hosted proxy between coding agents and LLM providers. It records the exact cost of every request and enforces hard per-key budgets through two-phase reserve and settle accounting over a crash-safe journal. One Go binary with zero external dependencies, backed by SQLite.

tfg.title: Real-time collaborative editor (Thesis)
tfg.description: Real-time collaborative coding platform integrated into Moodle. Edits sync through CRDTs (Yjs) via Hocuspocus and events are published to Apache Kafka. The whole stack runs on Docker Compose and is validated with Selenium E2E tests with up to 10 concurrent users.

myCloudDocs.title: myCloudDocs
myCloudDocs.description: Documentation of projects deployed on AWS: a three-tier web app, a serverless pipeline with S3, Lambda and DynamoDB, and WordPress on EC2 with Aurora.

eterna.title: Eterna
eterna.description: Watch e-commerce built with Next.js, MongoDB and Tailwind CSS, with a REST API and JWT authentication.

deviceManagementApp.title: Device Management
deviceManagementApp.description: Team project using Scrum, C#, Blazor and SQLite, tested with xUnit and shipped through CI/CD on Azure DevOps.

inteligentes.title: Urban graph search
inteligentes.description: Informed and uninformed search algorithms (BFS, DFS, A* and best-first) over a city's street graph, in Python.
